features.label: Written for no one
features.detail: A private notebook, never meant to be published. You are reading a man argue with himself, not perform wisdom for an audience.

features.label: Power as the test
features.detail: He held absolute authority and spent the whole book distrusting it. The philosophy is harder because of the job, not easier.

features.label: Repetition as evidence
features.detail: He says the same things over and over because he kept failing at them. The practice has a poor success rate by design.
